goal.slice_title: deterministic depth-1 planner plus resource-trace binding contract
goal.statement: Design a fail-closed, frozen finite-domain depth-1 action decision and deterministic resource-trace binding contract without implementing or executing a planner.

required_contract_questions: Freeze U, Checker and counterexample results, exact action-catalog identity, and current resource-budget declaration.
Define V(a)=E[|U|-|U_o|] for deterministic observations without learned probabilities, stochastic observation, planning confidence, or hidden ground truth.
Define an exact deterministic tie-break and explicit ABSTAIN or DENY when no qualifying action exists.
Define a planner decision record that binds the selected action, all input identities, exact value calculation, tie-break basis, and a deterministic subsequent resource-trace attempt identifier.
Fail closed on stochastic or missing observation models, stale hashes, wildcard catalogs, hidden or oracle identifiers, resource-trace mismatch, and any STOP request.
Plan fixed-case decision-to-resource-trace binding tests without production action execution or finite-domain expansion.

explicit_non_substitutes.reason: not a frozen Part A Kernel D1 decision implementation

explicit_non_substitutes.artifact: P4 action selection, P5 deterministic executor, or P10 E2E driver
explicit_non_substitutes.reason: no D1 value or next-action decision policy

hard_boundaries: Specification is not authority; this GO opens only the A17-P1e RED grid cell.
